issue: Glossary break: бухгалтер is 'accountant' (GLOSSARY, Institutions); here 'bookkeeper'.
Stiff calque: 'going into everything' is not idiomatic English; «иду на все» = am ready to do anything.
russian: Но иду на все из-за него
old: But I’m going into everything for his sake
new: But I’m ready to do anything for his sake

issue: Ambiguous word: in US English (the edition's spelling standard) 'homely' means plain/unattractive, not 'informal, for home'. «домашний наряд» = clothes worn at home.
Consistency: Margarita is addressed as capitalised 'Queen' everywhere else in ch. 23–24 (e.g. 23:3, 23:28, 24:7); only here lower case.
Wrong connotation: 'smearing' reads as slander in English; «пачкотня» is messy daubing, scribble.
Same as 22:66 (the cat echoes Woland's word): 'smearing' suggests slander; «пачкотня» = daubing.
Consistency: the cat's «бинокль» was introduced as 'a lady’s mother-of-pearl opera glass' (22:60, 22:62, 22:69, 22:75); here it becomes plural 'opera glasses'.
Stumbling phrasing: 'And what was what was this' reads as a typo (doubled 'what was'); the echo of 24:269 is better kept with a clean sentence. «Дело же было вот в чем».
russian: Дело же было вот в чем
old: And what was what was this:
new: And here is what was what:

issue: Wrong sense: «кверху ногами» is 'upside down' (feet in the air, as Mogarych in 24:198 'was turned upside down'), not 'feet first'.
russian: через это окно кверху ногами вылетел во двор
old: he flew out into the courtyard feet first
new: he flew out into the courtyard upside down

issue: Invented detail: «зарежут» means he will be knifed (killed with a knife), not that his throat will be cut. In 26:62 Judas is stabbed in the back and the heart, so 'throat' contradicts the narrative it sets up. The same rendering recurs in 25:117–119 and throughout ch. 26 (26:66, 88, 102, 109, 114, 227–231), outside this review's range.
old: that his throat will be cut tonight
new: that he will be knifed tonight

issue: Ungrammatical: 'it is chance' uses the noun as an adjective; «они случайны» = the information is fortuitous/haphazard.
russian: тем более что они случайны, темны и недостоверны
old: since it is chance, obscure and unreliable
new: since it is haphazard, obscure and unreliable

issue: Same as 25:107: «зарезать» = to knife, not specifically to cut the throat.
old: to track a man down, cut his throat,
new: to track a man down, knife him,

issue: Same as 25:107: «зарежут» = he will be knifed.
russian: И тем не менее его зарежут сегодня
old: And nevertheless his throat will be cut tonight
new: And nevertheless he will be knifed tonight

issue: Same as 25:107: «Так зарежут» = So he will be knifed.
old: So his throat will be cut, hegemon?
new: So he will be knifed, hegemon?
